//go:build windows

package windows

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
	win "golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

type cacheGatePositiveValue struct {
	PureEOF            bool
	API                string
	Started, Completed time.Time
	Error              string
	Errno              uint32
	Size               int64
	MTime              uint64
	Identity           uint64
	Volume             uint32
	Count              uint32
	Digest             string
	Offset             int64
}
type cacheGatePositiveMutation struct {
	Kind         string
	Acknowledged time.Time
	Attr         storage.Attr
	Effects      storage.FileEffects
}
type cacheGatePositiveFirst struct {
	Phase    string
	Native   cacheGatePositiveValue
	Expected storage.Attr
	Passed   bool
}

type cacheGatePositiveCell struct {
	postDeadline            bool
	PostDeadline            *cacheGatePostDeadlineResult
	ExposureSource          cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	IOModel                 string
	First                   []cacheGatePositiveFirst
	Name, Mode              string
	Exposed, EarliestExpiry time.Time
	Mutations               []cacheGatePositiveMutation
	Native                  []cacheGatePositiveValue
}

func cacheGatePositiveDigest(data []byte) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func cacheGatePositiveTime(t time.Time) uint64 {
	ft := win.NsecToFiletime(t.UnixNano())
	return uint64(ft.HighDateTime)<<32 | uint64(ft.LowDateTime)
}
func cacheGatePositiveError(v *cacheGatePositiveValue, err error) {
	v.Completed = time.Now()
	if err != nil {
		v.Error = err.Error()
		var code syscall.Errno
		if errors.As(err, &code) {
			v.Errno = uint32(code)
		}
	}
}

func cacheGatePositivePath(path string) cacheGatePositiveValue {
	v := cacheGatePositiveValue{API: "GetFileAttributesExW", Started: time.Now()}
	name, err := win.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
		return v
	}
	var data win.Win32FileAttributeData
	err = win.GetFileAttributesEx(name, win.GetFileExInfoStandard, (*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&data)))
	cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
	if err == nil {
		v.Size = int64(uint64(data.FileSizeHigh)<<32 | uint64(data.FileSizeLow))
		v.MTime = uint64(data.LastWriteTime.HighDateTime)<<32 | uint64(data.LastWriteTime.LowDateTime)
	}
	return v
}
func cacheGatePositiveInfo(file *nativeHandle, class uint32) cacheGatePositiveValue {
	v := cacheGatePositiveValue{API: fmt.Sprintf("GetFileInformationByHandleEx(%d)", class), Started: time.Now()}
	var data [40]byte
	size := uint32(40)
	if class == win.FileStandardInfo {
		size = 24
	}
	err := win.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(file.value, class, &data[0], size)
	cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
	if err == nil {
		if class == win.FileBasicInfo {
			v.MTime = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(data[16:24])
		} else {
			v.Size = int64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(data[8:16]))
		}
	}
	return v
}
func cacheGatePositiveIdentity(file *nativeHandle) cacheGatePositiveValue {
	v := cacheGatePositiveValue{API: "GetFileInformationByHandle", Started: time.Now()}
	var info win.ByHandleFileInformation
	err := win.GetFileInformationByHandle(file.value, &info)
	cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
	if err == nil {
		v.Identity = uint64(info.FileIndexHigh)<<32 | uint64(info.FileIndexLow)
		v.Volume = info.VolumeSerialNumber
		v.Size = int64(uint64(info.FileSizeHigh)<<32 | uint64(info.FileSizeLow))
	}
	return v
}
func cacheGatePositiveOpen(t *testing.T, path string) (*nativeHandle, cacheGatePositiveValue) {
	t.Helper()
	v := cacheGatePositiveValue{API: "CreateFileW(READ,OPEN_EXISTING)", Started: time.Now()}
	name, err := win.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
		return nil, v
	}
	h, err := win.CreateFile(name, win.GENERIC_READ, win.FILE_SHARE_READ|win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, win.OPEN_EXISTING, win.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL|win.FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED, 0)
	cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, v
	}
	file := &nativeHandle{value: h}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := file.close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	return file, v
}
func cacheGatePositiveRead(file *nativeHandle, offset int64, deadline time.Time) (cacheGatePositiveValue, []byte) {
	v := cacheGatePositiveValue{API: "ReadFile(overlapped)", Started: time.Now(), Offset: offset}
	data := make([]byte, 1024)
	event, err := win.CreateEvent(nil, 1, 0, nil)
	if err != nil {
		cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
		return v, nil
	}
	overlap := win.Overlapped{HEvent: event, Offset: uint32(offset), OffsetHigh: uint32(uint64(offset) >> 32)}
	err = win.ReadFile(file.value, data, nil, &overlap)
	if err == nil || errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
		if errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
			remain := time.Until(deadline)
			status := uint32(win.WAIT_TIMEOUT)
			var waitErr error
			if remain > 0 {
				status, waitErr = win.WaitForSingleObject(event, uint32((remain+time.Millisecond-1)/time.Millisecond))
			}
			if waitErr != nil || status != uint32(win.WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
				cancelErr := win.CancelIoEx(file.value, &overlap)
				if errors.Is(cancelErr, win.ERROR_NOT_FOUND) {
					cancelErr = nil
				}
				completionErr := win.GetOverlappedResult(file.value, &overlap, &v.Count, true)
				err = errors.Join(context.DeadlineExceeded, waitErr, cancelErr, completionErr)
			} else {
				err = win.GetOverlappedResult(file.value, &overlap, &v.Count, false)
			}
		} else {
			err = win.GetOverlappedResult(file.value, &overlap, &v.Count, false)
		}
	}
	closeErr := win.CloseHandle(event)
	v.PureEOF = cacheGatePositivePureEOF(err, closeErr)
	err = errors.Join(err, closeErr)
	runtime.KeepAlive(data)
	runtime.KeepAlive(&overlap)
	cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
	if v.Count > uint32(len(data)) {
		v.Error = "native read count exceeds supplied buffer"
		return v, nil
	}
	data = data[:v.Count]
	v.Digest = cacheGatePositiveDigest(data)
	return v, data
}
func cacheGatePositiveCapture(kind string, session uint64, reference storage.FileReferenceID, attr storage.Attr, offset int64, data []byte) {
	cacheGateObserve("positive_authority", map[string]any{"kind": kind, "session": session, "reference": reference, "node_id": attr.ID, "revision": attr.MetadataRevision, "size": attr.Size, "mtime": cacheGatePositiveTime(attr.ModTime), "offset": offset, "count": len(data), "digest": cacheGatePositiveDigest(data)})
}
func cacheGatePositivePayload(length int, salt byte) []byte {
	out := make([]byte, length)
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = byte((i*37+i/17)%251) ^ salt
	}
	return out
}

func (p *cacheGatePositiveCell) record(v cacheGatePositiveValue) cacheGatePositiveValue {
	p.Native = append(p.Native, v)
	cacheGateObserve("positive_native", v)
	return v
}
func (p *cacheGatePositiveCell) timing(t *testing.T, v cacheGatePositiveValue, ack time.Time) {
	t.Helper()
	if !v.Completed.Before(p.EarliestExpiry) {
		t.Error("native observation crossed the earliest possible cache expiry")
	}
	if v.Completed.Before(ack) || v.Completed.Sub(ack) > time.Second {
		t.Error("native observation did not complete within one second of HTTP acknowledgement")
	}
}
func (p *cacheGatePositiveCell) mutation(t *testing.T, kind string, fn func() (storage.FileActionReceipt, error)) storage.Attr {
	t.Helper()
	receipt, err := fn()
	ack := time.Now()
	p.Mutations = append(p.Mutations, cacheGatePositiveMutation{Kind: kind, Acknowledged: ack, Attr: receipt.Observation.Attr, Effects: receipt.Effects})
	cacheGateObserve("positive_http_ack", p.Mutations[len(p.Mutations)-1])
	if err != nil || receipt.State != storage.FileActionCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("HTTP %s outcome=%+v error=%v", kind, receipt, err)
	}
	if !ack.Before(p.EarliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatal("HTTP acknowledgement crossed the earliest possible cache expiry")
	}
	return receipt.Observation.Attr
}
func cacheGatePositiveInitial(t *testing.T, session storage.FileSession, file storage.File, data []byte, year int) storage.Attr {
	t.Helper()
	nativeRemoteWrite(t, session, file, data)
	old := time.Date(year, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	receipt, err := file.SetAttr(t.Context(), storage.AttrChange{ModTime: &old}, nativeAction(t, session))
	if err != nil || receipt.State != storage.FileActionCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("prepare distinct modification time: %+v %v", receipt, err)
	}
	return receipt.Observation.Attr
}
func cacheGatePositiveOracle(t *testing.T, file storage.File, attr storage.Attr, data []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	result, err := file.ReadAt(t.Context(), storage.FileReadRequest{Length: 1024})
	cacheGateObserve("positive_http_oracle", map[string]any{"node_id": result.Attr.ID, "revision": result.Attr.MetadataRevision, "size": result.Attr.Size, "mtime": cacheGatePositiveTime(result.Attr.ModTime), "count": len(result.Data), "digest": cacheGatePositiveDigest(result.Data), "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
	if err != nil || result.Attr.ID != attr.ID || result.Attr.Size != attr.Size || !result.Attr.ModTime.Equal(attr.ModTime) || !bytes.Equal(result.Data, data) {
		t.Fatalf("independent HTTP byte/metadata oracle failed: attr=%+v err=%v", result.Attr, err)
	}
}
func cacheGatePositiveRequire(t *testing.T, v cacheGatePositiveValue, attr storage.Attr, observe string, data []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	if v.Error != "" {
		t.Errorf("%s failed: %s", v.API, v.Error)
		return
	}
	switch observe {
	case "path":
		if v.Size != attr.Size || v.MTime != cacheGatePositiveTime(attr.ModTime) {
			t.Errorf("path attributes stale: got size=%d mtime=%d want size=%d mtime=%d", v.Size, v.MTime, attr.Size, cacheGatePositiveTime(attr.ModTime))
		}
	case "basic":
		if v.MTime != cacheGatePositiveTime(attr.ModTime) {
			t.Errorf("held BasicInfo mtime=%d want=%d", v.MTime, cacheGatePositiveTime(attr.ModTime))
		}
	case "standard":
		if v.Size != attr.Size {
			t.Errorf("held StandardInfo EOF=%d want=%d", v.Size, attr.Size)
		}
	case "read":
		if v.Count != uint32(len(data)) || v.Digest != cacheGatePositiveDigest(data) {
			t.Errorf("held ReadFile bytes stale: count=%d digest=%s", v.Count, v.Digest)
		}
	}
}
func cacheGatePositiveSelect(p *cacheGatePositiveCell, path string, h *nativeHandle, observe string, deadline time.Time) cacheGatePositiveValue {
	switch observe {
	case "path":
		return p.record(cacheGatePositivePath(path))
	case "basic":
		return p.record(cacheGatePositiveInfo(h, win.FileBasicInfo))
	case "standard":
		return p.record(cacheGatePositiveInfo(h, win.FileStandardInfo))
	case "read":
		v, _ := cacheGatePositiveRead(h, 0, deadline)
		return p.record(v)
	default:
		panic("invalid positive observer")
	}
}
func cacheGatePositiveEOFTail(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell, h *nativeHandle, data []byte, oldSize int, deadline time.Time) {
	t.Helper()
	if len(data) > oldSize {
		v, got := cacheGatePositiveRead(h, int64(oldSize), deadline)
		p.record(v)
		p.timing(t, v, deadline.Add(-time.Second))
		if v.Error != "" || !bytes.Equal(got, data[oldSize:]) {
			t.Errorf("grown tail not current: %+v", v)
		}
	}
	offsets := []int64{int64(len(data))}
	if oldSize > len(data) {
		offsets = append(offsets, int64(oldSize-1))
	}
	for _, offset := range offsets {
		v, _ := cacheGatePositiveRead(h, offset, deadline)
		p.record(v)
		p.timing(t, v, deadline.Add(-time.Second))
		if !v.PureEOF || v.Count != 0 {
			t.Errorf("EOF offset%d: %+v", offset, v)
		}
	}
}

func cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t *testing.T, path string) (*nativeHandle, cacheGatePositiveValue) {
	t.Helper()
	v := cacheGatePositiveValue{API: "CreateFileW(READ,synchronous)", Started: time.Now()}
	name, err := win.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
		return nil, v
	}
	h, err := win.CreateFile(name, win.GENERIC_READ, win.FILE_SHARE_READ|win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, win.OPEN_EXISTING, win.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, 0)
	cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, v
	}
	file := &nativeHandle{value: h}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := file.close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	return file, v
}
func cacheGatePositiveReadSync(file *nativeHandle) cacheGatePositiveValue {
	v := cacheGatePositiveValue{API: "ReadFile(synchronous)", Started: time.Now()}
	data := make([]byte, 1024)
	err := win.ReadFile(file.value, data, &v.Count, nil)
	cacheGatePositiveError(&v, err)
	if v.Count > uint32(len(data)) {
		v.Error = "native read count exceeds supplied buffer"
		return v
	}
	v.Digest = cacheGatePositiveDigest(data[:v.Count])
	return v
}
func cacheGatePositiveSeek(t *testing.T, file *nativeHandle, offset int64) {
	t.Helper()
	started := time.Now()
	position, err := win.Seek(file.value, offset, 0)
	cacheGateObserve("positive_seek", map[string]any{"api": "SetFilePointer via x/sys/windows.Seek", "started": started, "completed": time.Now(), "requested": offset, "position": position, "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
	if err != nil || position != offset {
		t.Fatalf("prepare native read offset: position=%d error=%v", position, err)
	}
}

func cacheGatePositiveFresh(t *testing.T, v cacheGatePositiveValue, observe, name string, attr storage.Attr, want []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(200 * time.Millisecond)
	for {
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		if incomplete {
			t.Error("positive wire trace is incomplete")
			return
		}
		for _, request := range records {
			if request.Response || request.At.Before(v.Started) || request.At.After(v.Completed) {
				continue
			}
			for _, response := range records {
				if !response.Response || response.Connection != request.Connection || response.MessageID != request.MessageID || response.Command != request.Command {
					continue
				}
				match := false
				switch observe {
				case "path", "open":
					match = request.Command == 5 && request.Name == name && response.Status == 0 && response.EOF == uint64(attr.Size) && response.MTime == cacheGatePositiveTime(attr.ModTime)
				case "absent":
					match = request.Command == 5 && request.Name == name && response.Status == 0xc000000f
				case "basic":
					match = request.Command == 16 && (request.QueryClass == 4 || request.QueryClass == 18 || request.QueryClass == 34) && response.Status == 0 && response.MTime == cacheGatePositiveTime(attr.ModTime)
				case "standard":
					match = request.Command == 16 && (request.QueryClass == 5 || request.QueryClass == 18 || request.QueryClass == 34) && response.Status == 0 && response.EOF == uint64(attr.Size)
				case "read", "sync":
					match = request.Command == 8 && request.Offset == 0 && response.Status == 0 && response.Count == uint32(len(want)) && response.Digest == cacheGatePositiveDigest(want)
				}
				if match {
					cacheGateObserve("positive_fresh_proof", map[string]any{"api": v.API, "connection": response.Connection, "message_id": response.MessageID, "command": response.Command, "query_class": response.QueryClass, "eof": response.EOF, "mtime": response.MTime, "count": response.Count, "digest": response.Digest})
					return
				}
			}
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Errorf("selected first %s result has no matching current authoritative SMB response", v.API)
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}
func cacheGatePositiveSizeCell(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell, bridge *nativeBridge, observe, change string) {
	session, file := nativeRemoteOpen(t, bridge.remote, "target.bin", storage.NodeRegular, true)
	before := cacheGatePositivePayload(257, 0x17)
	after := cacheGatePositivePayload(769, 0x89)
	if change == "shrink" {
		before = cacheGatePositivePayload(769, 0x17)
		after = before[:73]
	}
	initial := cacheGatePositiveInitial(t, session, file, before, 2001)
	path := filepath.Join(bridge.path+`\`, "target.bin")
	var h *nativeHandle
	if observe != "path" {
		var opened cacheGatePositiveValue
		if observe == "sync" || observe == "basic" || observe == "standard" {
			h, opened = cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t, path)
		} else {
			h, opened = cacheGatePositiveOpen(t, path)
		}
		p.record(opened)
		if h == nil {
			t.Fatalf("open target: %s", opened.Error)
		}
		identity := p.record(cacheGatePositiveIdentity(h))
		if identity.Error != "" || identity.Identity != initial.ID {
			t.Fatalf("initial native identity is not the authority node: %+v", identity)
		}
	}
	for range 2 {
		var v cacheGatePositiveValue
		if observe == "sync" {
			cacheGatePositiveSeek(t, h, 0)
			v = p.record(cacheGatePositiveReadSync(h))
		} else {
			v = cacheGatePositiveSelect(p, path, h, observe, time.Now().Add(time.Second))
		}
		selected := observe
		if selected == "sync" {
			selected = "read"
		}
		cacheGatePositiveRequire(t, v, initial, selected, before)
	}
	if t.Failed() {
		t.Fatal("target warming failed")
	}
	if observe == "sync" {
		cacheGatePositiveSeek(t, h, 0)
	}
	if p.postDeadline {
		cacheGatePostDeadlineIdle(t)
	}
	action := nativeAction(t, session)
	var expected storage.Attr
	if change == "grow" {
		expected = p.mutation(t, change, func() (storage.FileActionReceipt, error) {
			return file.WriteAt(t.Context(), storage.FileWriteRequest{Data: after}, action)
		})
	} else {
		expected = p.mutation(t, change, func() (storage.FileActionReceipt, error) {
			return file.Truncate(t.Context(), storage.FileTruncateRequest{Size: 73}, action)
		})
	}
	ack := p.Mutations[len(p.Mutations)-1].Acknowledged
	if cacheGatePositiveTime(expected.ModTime) == cacheGatePositiveTime(initial.ModTime) {
		t.Fatal("measured mutation did not change the timestamp at native precision")
	}
	if p.postDeadline {
		cacheGatePostDeadlineObserve(t, p, path, file, initial, expected, after, ack)
		return
	}
	var first cacheGatePositiveValue
	if observe == "sync" {
		first = p.record(cacheGatePositiveReadSync(h))
	} else {
		first = cacheGatePositiveSelect(p, path, h, observe, ack.Add(time.Second))
	}
	p.timing(t, first, ack)
	selected := observe
	if selected == "sync" {
		selected = "read"
	}
	cacheGatePositiveRequire(t, first, expected, selected, after)
	cacheGatePositiveFresh(t, first, observe, "target.bin", expected, after)
	p.First = append(p.First, cacheGatePositiveFirst{Phase: change, Native: first, Expected: expected, Passed: !t.Failed()})
	cacheGatePositiveOracle(t, file, expected, after)
	if h != nil {
		identity := p.record(cacheGatePositiveIdentity(h))
		if identity.Error != "" || identity.Identity != initial.ID {
			t.Errorf("retained native identity changed: %+v", identity)
		}
		if observe == "read" {
			cacheGatePositiveEOFTail(t, p, h, after, len(before), ack.Add(time.Second))
		}
		if observe == "sync" {
			if len(after) > len(before) {
				cacheGatePositiveSeek(t, h, int64(len(before)))
				tail := p.record(cacheGatePositiveReadSync(h))
				p.timing(t, tail, ack)
				if tail.Error != "" || tail.Count != uint32(len(after)-len(before)) || tail.Digest != cacheGatePositiveDigest(after[len(before):]) {
					t.Errorf("synchronous grown tail stale: %+v", tail)
				}
			}
			offsets := []int64{int64(len(after))}
			if len(before) > len(after) {
				offsets = append(offsets, int64(len(before)-1))
			}
			for _, offset := range offsets {
				cacheGatePositiveSeek(t, h, offset)
				eof := p.record(cacheGatePositiveReadSync(h))
				p.timing(t, eof, ack)
				if eof.Error != "" || eof.Count != 0 {
					t.Errorf("synchronous EOF must succeed with zero bytes: %+v", eof)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
func cacheGatePositiveTTL(t *testing.T) time.Duration {
	t.Helper()
	seconds, err := strconv.ParseUint(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_MIN_CACHE_TTL"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil || seconds <= 1 {
		t.Fatal("verified cache lifetime above one second required")
	}
	return time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
}

func cacheGatePositiveRename(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell, session storage.FileSession, file, parent storage.File, source, destination string) storage.Attr {
	t.Helper()
	request := storage.RenameRequest{Source: nativeTestTarget(t, parent, source), Destination: nativeTestTarget(t, parent, destination)}
	action := nativeAction(t, session)
	return p.mutation(t, "rename "+source+" -> "+destination, func() (storage.FileActionReceipt, error) { return file.Rename(t.Context(), request, action) })
}
func cacheGatePositiveCheckHandle(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell, h *nativeHandle, attr storage.Attr, data []byte, deadline time.Time, detached bool) {
	t.Helper()
	cacheGatePositiveSeek(t, h, 0)
	v := p.record(cacheGatePositiveReadSync(h))
	p.timing(t, v, deadline.Add(-time.Second))
	if v.Error != "" || v.Count != uint32(len(data)) || v.Digest != cacheGatePositiveDigest(data) {
		t.Errorf("retained handle bytes changed identity: %+v", v)
	}
	identity := p.record(cacheGatePositiveIdentity(h))
	p.timing(t, identity, deadline.Add(-time.Second))
	if identity.Error != "" {
		cacheGateObserve("positive_identity_query_gap", map[string]any{"detached": detached, "result": identity})
		t.Errorf("native identity query unavailable (fixture/API gap): %+v", identity)
	} else if identity.Identity != attr.ID {
		t.Errorf("native identity=%d want=%d", identity.Identity, attr.ID)
	}
	for _, class := range []uint32{win.FileBasicInfo, win.FileStandardInfo} {
		info := p.record(cacheGatePositiveInfo(h, class))
		p.timing(t, info, deadline.Add(-time.Second))
		observe := "basic"
		if class == win.FileStandardInfo {
			observe = "standard"
		}
		cacheGatePositiveRequire(t, info, attr, observe, data)
	}
}
func cacheGatePositiveFreshOpen(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell, path string, attr storage.Attr, data []byte, deadline time.Time) {
	t.Helper()
	h, v := cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t, path)
	p.record(v)
	p.timing(t, v, deadline.Add(-time.Second))
	if h == nil {
		t.Errorf("fresh same-name open failed: %+v", v)
		return
	}
	cacheGatePositiveCheckHandle(t, p, h, attr, data, deadline, false)
	if err := h.close(); err != nil {
		t.Error(err)
	}
}
func cacheGatePositiveNamespaceCell(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell, bridge *nativeBridge, kind, observe string) {
	session, parent := nativeRemoteOpen(t, bridge.remote, "", storage.NodeDirectory, false)
	a := nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "target.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
	contentA := cacheGatePositivePayload(257, 0x19)
	attrA := cacheGatePositiveInitial(t, session, a, contentA, 2001)
	contentB := cacheGatePositivePayload(769, 0x93)
	var b storage.File
	var attrB storage.Attr
	if kind == "replace" {
		b = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "replacement.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
		attrB = cacheGatePositiveInitial(t, session, b, contentB, 2002)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(bridge.path+`\`, "target.bin")
	h, opened := cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t, path)
	p.record(opened)
	if h == nil {
		t.Fatalf("open original target: %+v", opened)
	}
	identity := p.record(cacheGatePositiveIdentity(h))
	if identity.Error != "" || identity.Identity != attrA.ID {
		t.Fatalf("original identity not established: %+v", identity)
	}
	for range 2 {
		cacheGatePositiveRequire(t, p.record(cacheGatePositivePath(path)), attrA, "path", contentA)
		if observe == "open" {
			warm, v := cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t, path)
			p.record(v)
			if warm == nil {
				t.Fatalf("warm same-name open: %+v", v)
			}
			if err := warm.close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
	if t.Failed() {
		t.Fatal("namespace target warming failed")
	}
	if kind == "replace" {
		attrB = cacheGatePositiveRename(t, p, session, b, parent, "replacement.bin", "target.bin")
	} else {
		attrA = cacheGatePositiveRename(t, p, session, a, parent, "target.bin", "away.bin")
		ack := p.Mutations[len(p.Mutations)-1].Acknowledged
		absent := cacheGatePositiveMissing(t, p, path, observe)
		p.timing(t, absent, ack)
		if absent.Errno != uint32(win.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) {
			t.Errorf("old name survived rename: %+v", absent)
		}
		cacheGatePositiveFresh(t, absent, "absent", "target.bin", storage.Attr{}, nil)
		p.First = append(p.First, cacheGatePositiveFirst{Phase: "rename absence", Native: absent, Passed: !t.Failed()})
		cacheGatePositiveCheckHandle(t, p, h, attrA, contentA, ack.Add(time.Second), false)
		cacheGatePositiveFreshOpen(t, p, filepath.Join(bridge.path+`\`, "away.bin"), attrA, contentA, ack.Add(time.Second))
		cacheGatePositiveOracle(t, a, attrA, contentA)
		if kind == "rename" {
			return
		}
		if t.Failed() {
			t.Fatal("rename-away phase failed before recreate")
		}
		for range 2 {
			negative := cacheGatePositiveMissing(t, p, path, observe)
			if negative.Errno != uint32(win.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) {
				t.Fatalf("selected negative view was not established before recreate: %+v", negative)
			}
		}
		b = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "target.bin", storage.NodeRegular)
		action := nativeAction(t, session)
		attrB = p.mutation(t, "recreate write", func() (storage.FileActionReceipt, error) {
			return b.WriteAt(t.Context(), storage.FileWriteRequest{Data: contentB}, action)
		})
	}
	ack := p.Mutations[len(p.Mutations)-1].Acknowledged
	var first cacheGatePositiveValue
	var fresh *nativeHandle
	if observe == "open" {
		fresh, first = cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t, path)
		p.record(first)
	} else {
		first = p.record(cacheGatePositivePath(path))
	}
	p.timing(t, first, ack)
	if observe == "open" {
		if fresh == nil {
			t.Errorf("first same-name open failed: %+v", first)
		}
	} else {
		cacheGatePositiveRequire(t, first, attrB, "path", contentB)
	}
	cacheGatePositiveFresh(t, first, observe, "target.bin", attrB, contentB)
	p.First = append(p.First, cacheGatePositiveFirst{Phase: kind, Native: first, Expected: attrB, Passed: !t.Failed()})
	cacheGatePositiveOracle(t, b, attrB, contentB)
	if fresh != nil {
		cacheGatePositiveCheckHandle(t, p, fresh, attrB, contentB, ack.Add(time.Second), false)
	} else {
		cacheGatePositiveFreshOpen(t, p, path, attrB, contentB, ack.Add(time.Second))
	}
	cacheGatePositiveCheckHandle(t, p, h, attrA, contentA, ack.Add(time.Second), kind == "replace")
	if attrA.ID == attrB.ID {
		t.Error("replacement identities are not distinct")
	}
}

func cacheGatePositiveScenario(t *testing.T, variant string) {
	postDeadline := strings.HasPrefix(variant, "positive_postdeadline_")
	mode := strings.TrimPrefix(variant, "positive_")
	if postDeadline {
		mode = strings.TrimPrefix(variant, "positive_postdeadline_")
	}
	if mode != "unheld" && mode != "exclusive" {
		t.Fatal("invalid positive-cache mode")
	}
	cells := []string{"path_grow", "path_shrink", "basic_grow", "basic_shrink", "standard_grow", "standard_shrink", "read_grow", "read_shrink", "sync_grow", "sync_shrink", "rename_path", "replace_path", "replace_open", "recreate_path", "recreate_open"}
	if postDeadline {
		cells = []string{"postdeadline_path_growth_witness"}
	}
	verdicts := map[string]bool{}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		report := map[string]any{"evidence_kind": "pinned prototype diagnostic; not PR implementation acceptance", "variant": variant, "fixture_sha": os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_FIXTURE_SHA"), "gate_sha": os.Getenv("GITHUB_SHA"), "overlay_sha": os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OVERLAY_SHA"), "missing_status_overlay_sha": os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_MISSING_STATUS_SHA"), "cells": verdicts, "test_failed": t.Failed()}
		if postDeadline {
			report["evidence_kind"] = "post-deadline witness collection; not one-second SLO acceptance"
			report["within_one_second_proven"] = false
			report["contract_result"] = "see witness classification; a current late sample is inconclusive"
		}
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "receipt.json"), data, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	for _, name := range cells {
		verdicts[name] = t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			trace := &cacheGateTrace{}
			cacheGateActive.Store(trace)
			cacheGateResetPositiveWire()
			cell := &cacheGatePositiveCell{Name: name, Mode: mode, IOModel: "synchronous", postDeadline: postDeadline}
			if postDeadline {
				cell.IOModel = "path-only"
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "read_") {
				cell.IOModel = "overlapped"
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "path_") {
				cell.IOModel = "path-only"
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "sync_") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "basic_") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "standard_") {
				cell.IOModel = "synchronous"
			}
			var bridge *nativeBridge
			t.Cleanup(func() {
				cacheGateActive.Store(nil)
				records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
				evidenceValid := !incomplete
				for _, r := range records {
					if r.Command == 15 {
						evidenceValid = false
						t.Error("positive no-watcher probe issued CHANGE_NOTIFY")
					}
					if r.Response && r.Command == 5 && (r.Oplock != 0 && !(r.Oplock == 0xff && r.LeasePresent && r.LeaseState == 0) || r.LeaseState != 0) {
						evidenceValid = false
						t.Error("positive probe received caching rights")
					}
				}
				trace.mu.Lock()
				events := append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events...)
				overflow, encodingError := trace.overflow, trace.encodingError
				trace.mu.Unlock()
				if incomplete || overflow || encodingError != nil {
					evidenceValid = false
					t.Errorf("positive evidence incomplete: wire=%v events=%v encoding=%v", incomplete, overflow, encodingError)
				}
				report := map[string]any{"evidence_kind": "pinned prototype diagnostic; not PR implementation acceptance", "variant": variant, "cell": cell, "test_failed": t.Failed(), "wire_incomplete": incomplete, "trace_overflow": overflow, "events": events, "wire": records}
				if bridge != nil {
					status := bridge.smb.Status()
					refs := bridge.backend.openReferences()
					report["final_server_status"] = status
					report["final_backend_references"] = refs
					if refs != 0 || status.Connections != 0 || status.RetainedConnections != 0 || status.PendingRequests != 0 || status.UnconfirmedMutations != 0 || status.CleanupFailures != 0 {
						evidenceValid = false
						t.Error("positive cell cleanup retained resources or unknown effects")
					}
				}
				if postDeadline {
					report["within_one_second_proven"] = false
					report["contract_result"] = "inconclusive"
					if cell.PostDeadline != nil {
						if !evidenceValid || t.Failed() {
							cell.PostDeadline.Classification = "invalid_or_inconclusive"
							cell.PostDeadline.ContractResult = "inconclusive"
						}
						report["contract_result"] = cell.PostDeadline.ContractResult
						if cell.PostDeadline.ContractResult == "violated" {
							t.Errorf("path attributes remained stale after one second: %+v", cell.PostDeadline.Native)
						}
					}
				}
				report["test_failed"] = t.Failed()
				data, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
				if err != nil {
					t.Error(err)
					return
				}
				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "positive-"+name+".json"), data, 0600); err != nil {
					t.Error(err)
				}
			})
			sid, err := CurrentUserSID()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			policy, err := AllowSID(sid)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			bridge = nativeBridgeFixture(t, policy)
			if err := bridge.mapDrive(t); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			proof := nativeOpen(t, filepath.Join(bridge.path+`\`, "lease-proof.bin"), win.CREATE_ALWAYS)
			if n, err := nativeTransfer(proof, []byte{1}, true); err != nil || n != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("exercise zero-rights lease: n=%d error=%v", n, err)
			}
			bridge.assertCacheContract(t)
			if err := proof.close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if mode == "exclusive" {
				root, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, bridge.path+`\`, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, 0, true)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("exclusive root open: %v", err)
				}
				if root == nil {
					t.Fatal("exclusive root handle absent")
				}
			}
			cacheGatePositiveExposure(t, cell)
			if postDeadline {
				cacheGatePositiveSizeCell(t, cell, bridge, "path", "grow")
				return
			}
			parts := strings.SplitN(name, "_", 2)
			if parts[1] == "grow" || parts[1] == "shrink" {
				cacheGatePositiveSizeCell(t, cell, bridge, parts[0], parts[1])
			} else {
				cacheGatePositiveNamespaceCell(t, cell, bridge, parts[0], parts[1])
			}
		})
	}
}

func cacheGateOptionalPositiveObserver() *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver {
	if strings.HasPrefix(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_VARIANT"), "positive_") {
		return cacheGateNewPositiveFrameObserver()
	}
	return nil
}
func (c *nativeObservedConnection) Close() error {
	err := c.Conn.Close()
	if c.positive != nil {
		c.positive.finish()
	}
	return err
}

func cacheGatePositiveOwnMapping(local, share string) error {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_VARIANT"), "positive_") {
		return nil
	}
	record := map[string]string{"Local": local, "Remote": `\\127.0.0.1\` + share}
	data, err := json.Marshal(record)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	target := filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "owned-mapping-"+share+".json")
	pending := target + ".tmp"
	file, err := os.OpenFile(pending, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, writeErr := file.Write(data)
	if err := errors.Join(writeErr, file.Sync(), file.Close()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.Rename(pending, target)
}

func cacheGatePositiveMissing(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell, path, observe string) cacheGatePositiveValue {
	if observe == "open" {
		h, v := cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t, path)
		p.record(v)
		if h != nil {
			t.Error("expected missing name unexpectedly opened")
		}
		return v
	}
	return p.record(cacheGatePositivePath(path))
}

func cacheGatePositivePureEOF(completion, cleanup error) bool {
	return completion == win.ERROR_HANDLE_EOF && cleanup == nil
}

func TestGatePositiveReadCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name                string
		completion, cleanup error
		want                bool
	}{
		{"pureEOF", win.ERROR_HANDLE_EOF, nil, true},
		{"successfulRead", nil, nil, false},
		{"canceledWithEOF", errors.Join(context.DeadlineExceeded, win.ERROR_HANDLE_EOF), nil, false},
		{"waitFailedWithEOF", errors.Join(win.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, win.ERROR_HANDLE_EOF), nil, false},
		{"cleanupFailed", win.ERROR_HANDLE_EOF, win.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, false},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := cacheGatePositivePureEOF(test.completion, test.cleanup); got != test.want {
				t.Fatalf("pure EOF=%v want=%v", got, test.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func cacheGatePositiveExposure(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell) {
	records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if incomplete {
		t.Fatal("setup trace is incomplete")
	}
	for _, record := range records {
		if record.Response || record.Command != 5 {
			continue
		}
		if p.Exposed.IsZero() || record.At.Before(p.Exposed) {
			p.Exposed = record.At
			p.ExposureSource = record
		}
	}
	if p.Exposed.IsZero() {
		t.Fatal("native setup has no recorded CREATE exposure")
	}
	p.EarliestExpiry = p.Exposed.Add(cacheGatePositiveTTL(t))
	if !time.Now().Before(p.EarliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatal("setup crossed earliest possible directory-cache expiry")
	}
}

type cacheGatePostDeadlineResult struct {
	Classification        string                 `json:"classification"`
	ContractResult        string                 `json:"contract_result"`
	WithinOneSecondProven bool                   `json:"within_one_second_proven"`
	PlannedStartDelayNS   int64                  `json:"planned_start_delay_ns"`
	StartMinusAckNS       int64                  `json:"start_minus_ack_ns"`
	CompletionMinusAckNS  int64                  `json:"completion_minus_ack_ns"`
	Native                cacheGatePositiveValue `json:"native"`
	Warmed, Expected      storage.Attr
	QuietViolations       []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord `json:"quiet_violations"`
	NativeInterval        []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord `json:"native_interval"`
	MatchesWarmTuple      bool                          `json:"matches_warm_tuple"`
}

func cacheGatePostDeadlineIdle(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(200 * time.Millisecond)
	for {
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		if incomplete {
			t.Fatal("post-deadline witness has incomplete setup trace")
		}
		pending := map[[2]uint64]bool{}
		for _, record := range records {
			if record.Bootstrap || record.Command == 12 || record.Command == 13 {
				continue
			}
			key := [2]uint64{record.Connection, record.MessageID}
			if record.Response {
				if record.Status != 0x103 {
					delete(pending, key)
				}
			} else {
				pending[key] = true
			}
		}
		if len(pending) == 0 {
			return
		}
		if !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("native warm-up still has outstanding SMB operations")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

func cacheGatePostDeadlineObserve(t *testing.T, p *cacheGatePositiveCell, path string, file storage.File, warmed, expected storage.Attr, data []byte, ack time.Time) {
	t.Helper()
	result := &cacheGatePostDeadlineResult{Classification: "invalid_or_inconclusive", ContractResult: "inconclusive", PlannedStartDelayNS: int64(1100 * time.Millisecond), Warmed: warmed, Expected: expected}
	p.PostDeadline = result
	due := ack.Add(1100 * time.Millisecond)
	if !due.Before(p.EarliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatal("post-deadline witness has no pre-expiry observation window")
	}
	timer := time.NewTimer(time.Until(due))
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-timer.C:
	case <-t.Context().Done():
		t.Fatal(t.Context().Err())
	}
	first := p.record(cacheGatePositivePath(path))
	result.Native = first
	result.StartMinusAckNS = int64(first.Started.Sub(ack))
	result.CompletionMinusAckNS = int64(first.Completed.Sub(ack))
	if !first.Started.After(ack.Add(time.Second)) || !first.Started.Before(p.EarliestExpiry) || !first.Completed.Before(p.EarliestExpiry) {
		t.Fatal("post-deadline query did not remain strictly between one second and cache expiry")
	}
	if first.Error != "" {
		t.Fatalf("post-deadline native query failed: %+v", first)
	}
	// Waiting on recorded completions does not issue another native observation.
	cacheGatePostDeadlineIdle(t)
	records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if incomplete {
		t.Fatal("post-deadline witness trace is incomplete")
	}
	for _, record := range records {
		if record.Command == 13 {
			continue
		}
		if record.At.After(ack) && record.At.Before(first.Started) {
			result.QuietViolations = append(result.QuietViolations, record)
		}
		if !record.At.Before(first.Started) {
			result.NativeInterval = append(result.NativeInterval, record)
		}
	}
	if len(result.QuietViolations) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("an SMB operation interrupted the untouched post-ACK interval")
	}
	oracle, err := file.ReadAt(t.Context(), storage.FileReadRequest{Length: 1024})
	cacheGateObserve("postdeadline_http_oracle", map[string]any{"attr": oracle.Attr, "count": len(oracle.Data), "digest": cacheGatePositiveDigest(oracle.Data), "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
	if err != nil || oracle.Attr.ID != expected.ID || oracle.Attr.MetadataRevision != expected.MetadataRevision || oracle.Attr.Size != expected.Size || !oracle.Attr.ModTime.Equal(expected.ModTime) || !bytes.Equal(oracle.Data, data) {
		t.Fatal("post-deadline authority oracle changed or failed")
	}
	result.MatchesWarmTuple = first.Size == warmed.Size && first.MTime == cacheGatePositiveTime(warmed.ModTime)
	if first.Size != expected.Size || first.MTime != cacheGatePositiveTime(expected.ModTime) {
		result.Classification = "stale_after_one_second"
		result.ContractResult = "violated"
		return
	}
	result.Classification = "current_at_post_deadline_probe"
	// A current late sample cannot establish when it first became current.
	result.ContractResult = "inconclusive"
}
